creator: Alexander Terp
description: crates/muster-cli/src/daemon.rs open() uses a bare UnixStream::connect with no handshake timeout, so a daemon socket that accepts and stays silent hangs msg verbs and the windowless pane verbs - the failure muster-daemon-launch's own bounded dial (5 s handshake, SIGPIPE silenced) exists to avoid. connect_or_start (2026-10-05) calls the bounded ensure_running and then the unbounded connect_welcomed against the same socket. Predates that change; found reviewing it. The window side got a 2 s probe for the same failure (a_2ZNnSyiXR).
title: ⏳ A daemon that accepts and never answers hangs every muster msg verb
